competency.practice_task: Produce a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands grounded in an exploration-policy comparison.

required_evidence: a rerun manifest with data, version, seeds and commands
Include resource log and quality per unit of compute.
Report coverage and regret under fixed steps with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: rewarding novelty without task progress.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of exploration.
Practice: the rerun agrees within a predeclared tolerance.
Measurement: report coverage and regret under fixed steps against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for rewarding novelty without task progress; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
